The legacy runtime independently revalidates canonical object-kind syntax. Governed catalog transition checks prevent owner/objectKind changes, duplicate semantic owners, or untyped retirement, and the typed authority/source mapping is exhaustively tested across all 36 current pairs. Quint checks generic/domain separation and Lean proves independent reference semantics, but descriptor parsing, active-artifact lookup, whole-store write-path completeness, storage atomicity, and domain-internal invariants are not implementation-proved. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code.
